name: Six Senses Yao Noi
address: 56 Moo 5, Tambol Koh Yao Noi, Amphur Koh Yao, Phang Nga 82160, Thailand
tagline: Pool villas on Koh Yao Noi, about 45 minutes from Phuket by speedboat.
description:
Six Senses Yao Noi is on Koh Yao Noi, in Phang Nga Bay, about 45 minutes from Phuket, with the last part of the journey by speedboat. The address is 56 Moo 5, Tambol Koh Yao Noi, Amphur Koh Yao, Phang Nga 82160. Limestone islands stand in the bay. Hornbills use the grounds, and the resort keeps projects for the island's plants and birds.

The villas follow the stilted houses of southern Thailand. Each has a private infinity pool, a terrace and an outdoor sala, and a Guest Experience Maker, called a GEM, to arrange the day. The Hideaway Pool Villa and the Beachfront Pool Villa are each 154 square metres. The View is a one-bedroom villa of 225 square metres, with a 180-degree outlook across the bay and a hammock net above the pool. The Ocean Retreat is the largest two-bedroom villa, at 500 square metres, on two levels, with a path through the garden toward the beach.

The Living Room, close to the beach, serves a breakfast buffet and lunch and dinner from the wok or the grill, and it has a deli and a patisserie. Nithan is the main dining room, with private pavilions and a Chef's Table on the level above. The Hilltop is the highest table, open for a light lunch and a seasonal dinner, looking over the limestone. The Den is the bar, with daybeds hung above the floor. A barbecue can be laid on the beach or at the villa. The resort also has Six Senses Spa, a fitness room, a watersports centre and tennis.

Check-in is at 2:00 pm and check-out at noon. Children up to 11 stay free in the existing beds of a parent's room. Children of 5 and under eat free from the children's menu. Children from 6 to 11 pay the children's menu in full, and half the regular menu for a half portion.

Six Senses Yao Noi suits travellers who want a pool villa in the bay, with a GEM for boats and meals, and Phuket less than an hour away.
